steps.en: Payable or not is decided by notice type when the notice is created
steps.id: Bisa tidaknya dibayar ditentukan dari tipe notice saat notice dibuat

steps.en: Payable or not also follows the processing stage, including a court payment cutoff
steps.id: Bisa tidaknya dibayar juga mengikuti tahap pemrosesan, termasuk batas bayar court
steps.why_en: Stage rules only run on revival; the automatic court payment cutoff is switched off in the scheduler and runs only by hand.
steps.why_id: Aturan tahap hanya jalan saat revival; batas bayar court otomatis dimatikan di scheduler, hanya jalan manual.

steps.en: Outstanding notices are sent to the payment channels in real time
steps.id: Notice outstanding dikirim ke channel pembayaran secara real-time
steps.why_en: Notices are pushed in batches every 10 minutes, not instantly.
steps.why_id: Notice dikirim dalam batch tiap 10 menit, bukan seketika.

steps.en: A raised admin fee shows up as the amount to pay
steps.id: Admin fee yang naik tampil sebagai jumlah yang harus dibayar

steps.en: Offenders can search notices by notice number, vehicle number or ID
steps.id: Offender bisa cari notice lewat nomor notice, nomor kendaraan, atau ID

steps.en: Each notice is checked against the rules to decide if it can be paid
steps.id: Tiap notice dicek terhadap aturan untuk menentukan bisa dibayar atau tidak

steps.en: The AXS channel gets the same payable or not-payable decision
steps.id: Channel AXS mendapat keputusan bisa/tidak dibayar yang sama
steps.why_en: AXS uses its own filter, which hides some notices that eService still shows.
steps.why_id: AXS memakai filter sendiri yang menyembunyikan sebagian notice yang masih tampil di eService.

steps.en: Payable notices can be picked; others show the right instruction
steps.id: Notice yang bisa dibayar bisa dipilih; lainnya menampilkan instruksi yang tepat
